in_hebrew.name: Iolenta
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God's answer, light
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Iolenta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word hiólos, meaning 'godly, divine'. The suffix -enta is derived from the Latin word entus, meaning 'divine inspiration'. In Greek mythology, Iolaus was a hero and companion of Heracles. Iolenta can be interpreted as 'God's answer' or 'God's light'.
